pack.name: Sample: the granary year
pack.summary: A small pack that uses every block of the format. Grain, a mill fire and a harvest blessing.

tags.meaning: Grain is stored here. Stored grain feeds workers.
A harvest blessing lies on it this season.
Townsfolk walk the streets at night with lanterns.

things.name: Stone granary
things.text: Grain kept dry through the winter.
things.art: A round stone granary at the edge of gold fields, painterly.

things.name: Night watch
things.text: Lantern crews walk the streets after dark.
things.art: Two townsfolk with lanterns on a dark lane, painterly.

cards.title: Build a stone granary
cards.pitch: Half the grain rots in the barn. Give me 2 workers and 3 Materials and I will build a granary.

if_taken.say: The granary stands by the east fields.

if_expires.say: The grain rots. People go hungry.

cards.art: Masons raising a round stone wall beside a wheat field, painterly.

cards.title: Learn the harvest blessing
cards.pitch: I can teach you the harvest blessing for 1 Magic.

if_expires.say: The shrine keeper goes back up the mountain.

cards.art: A robed keeper holding a sheaf of wheat before a small shrine, painterly.

cards.title: Start a night watch
cards.pitch: Sparks fly from my millstones. Give me 1 worker for a night watch.

if_taken.say: Lanterns walk the streets at night.

if_expires.say: Nobody watches the streets at night.

cards.art: A miller pointing at sparks in a dark mill, painterly.

cards.title: Douse the mill before it catches
cards.pitch: The mill dust is ready to catch. Give me 2 Materials for wet sacking.

if_taken.say: Wet sacking hangs over the mill dust. No spark takes.

if_expires.say: The mill dust caught. The mill street burned.

cards.art: A mill wheel with smoke curling from the loft, painterly.

cards.title: Take in the neighbours' hungry
cards.pitch: The next town has no bread. Send 2 Materials of grain and their people will remember it.

if_taken.say: They swear to you and send 1 Materials each season.

if_expires.say: Their hungry walk to your gate. 40 people sleep in the road.

cards.art: A grain cart on a road between two towns, painterly.

cards.title: Fight the threshing fire
cards.pitch: The threshing floor is alight. Come now.

disaster.say: The granary and the east fields burn.

if_expires.say: Nobody came. The granary and the east fields burn.

cards.art: Flames on a threshing floor at dusk, figures with buckets, painterly.

rules.name: A full granary
rules.why: grain from {b} kept dry in {a} fed a new worker: +{n} Labor

rules.name: Blessed stores
rules.why: the blessing kept the mice out of {a}: +{n} Materials

rules.name: Lanterns at the fire
rules.why: the night watch saw it early and saved {n} of the burning lots

abilities.name: Harvest blessing
abilities.text: Cast it on a granary. Its stores are blessed this season.
abilities.look: a soft gold light settles on the roof

wants: An effect that makes a thing cost Labor each season while it stands.
